[[File:Ourania Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Ourania Teleport''' teleports the player outside of the [[Ourania Cave]] and the [[Ourania Altar]]. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell and 71 [[Magic]] is required.

Players must speak to [[Baba Yaga]] with Lunar spells active to unlock the ability to cast this spell. Before completion of the [[Elite Fremennik Diary]], this also requires a [[seal of passage]] equipped or in your inventory.
Speaking to Baba Yaga is '''not''' required to add the teleport to a [[portal chamber]] in a [[player-owned house]].

Unlike most other Lunar teleports, this spell does not have a corresponding tele group spell.
